skill.name: risk-management-specialist

Use for risk management planning, risk assessments, risk control verification, and risk management file maintenance.

content.value_statement: Medical device teams need consistent risk management evidence across design, regulatory, and post-market work. This skill guides ISO 14971 planning, analysis, controls, and file maintenance.
actual_capabilities: Guides ISO 14971 risk management planning across the device lifecycle.
Structures hazard identification, hazardous situation analysis, and risk estimation.
Supports risk evaluation using acceptability criteria and benefit-risk reasoning.
Helps define risk control measures and verification evidence.
Connects risk management with IEC 62304 software safety, cybersecurity, and human factors work.
Outlines risk management file maintenance for design changes and post-market information.
limitations: It does not replace qualified regulatory, clinical, legal, or quality review.
It does not certify compliance with ISO 14971, ISO 13485, FDA, or EU MDR requirements.
It needs product-specific evidence, clinical data, and risk acceptability criteria from the user.
The included script, reference, and asset files are placeholders, not production automation.

use_cases.title: Create Risk Management Plans
use_cases.description: Build an ISO 14971 plan with scope, responsibilities, criteria, lifecycle activities, and file structure.

use_cases.title: Review Design Risk Evidence
use_cases.description: Map hazards, foreseeable misuse, risk controls, and verification evidence during design control reviews.
use_cases.target_user: Systems engineers and design assurance engineers

use_cases.title: Assess Post-Market Signals
use_cases.description: Connect complaints, surveillance data, CAPA records, and clinical updates to risk file maintenance.
use_cases.target_user: Post-market surveillance and quality operations teams

prompt_templates.title: Start a Risk Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new device program.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ISO 14971 risk management plan outline for this medical device: [device type]. Include scope, responsibilities, criteria, lifecycle activities, and required records.

prompt_templates.title: Identify Hazards
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate hazard analysis for a defined device use case.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this intended use, user profile, and use environment: [details]. Identify likely hazards, hazardous situations, foreseeable misuse, and missing inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate Risk Controls
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of controls and verification evidence.
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess these proposed risk controls: [controls]. Check whether they follow the ISO 14971 control hierarchy and identify verification evidence needed for each control.

prompt_templates.title: Update a Risk File
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced lifecycle maintenance using post-market information.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these post-market signals and design changes: [details]. Recommend risk file updates, benefit-risk review needs, and follow-up quality actions.

output_examples.input: A wearable monitor is entering design verification, and the team needs a risk management file review.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a review plan covering intended use, hazards, hazardous situations, controls, verification records, residual risks, and missing traceability.

output_examples.input: A complaint trend suggests intermittent alarm delays in a connected infusion device.
output_examples.output: The skill links the signal to cybersecurity, software, use-error, and clinical risk questions, then recommends risk file and CAPA review actions.

output_examples.input: A team has risk controls but no clear verification strategy.
output_examples.output: The skill separates design controls, protective measures, and information for safety, then proposes verification evidence for each control type.

best_practices: Provide the device intended use, users, environments, hazards, and current acceptability criteria.
Ask for traceable outputs that link hazards, controls, verification evidence, and residual risk decisions.
Use the output as a review aid and route final decisions through your quality system.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated risk ratings as final without documented expert review.
Do not ask for generic hazards when product-specific use conditions are available.
Do not use the skill to bypass design control, CAPA, or regulatory review processes.

faq.question: What standard does this skill focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on ISO 14971 risk management for medical devices across planning, analysis, control, and post-production monitoring.

faq.question: Can it prepare a complete regulatory submission?
faq.answer: It can help organize risk content for submissions, but it does not replace regulatory strategy or submission author review.

faq.question: Does it support software risk management?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for connecting IEC 62304 software safety work with the overall risk management file.

faq.question: Can it address cybersecurity risks?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure cybersecurity threat modeling and patient safety impact analysis for connected medical devices.

faq.question: What inputs improve the output?
faq.answer: Useful inputs include intended use, device architecture, user profiles, hazards, controls, verification records, complaints, and surveillance data.

faq.question: Are the included scripts ready to use?
faq.answer: No. The repository includes placeholder script and reference files, so production automation would need separate implementation and review.
